evidence.reason: The fixture commits without disabling repository-local commit signing. A developer/CI global `commit.gpgSign=true` will make `git commit` attempt signing with the fixture identity (`fixture@example.invalid`), which commonly has no matching key, causing `setUp()` to fail for all fixture-based tests. Adding repo-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the commits is a small, ordinary test-hermeticity fix.
